title: The owner's fourth playtest notes and the A6 workshop survey: a second canyon pass as the penultimate wave, SOL-82 automated later (SOL-88 launched by the ARC-01), the Units lab to show SOL and the gunship with wireframes, and new base buildings (chip plant, greenhouse, bio containers, an armory where the tank refills shells)
context: Owner, 2026-10-01 evening, from the live build 7a54aaaf: "1) SOL first pass; very satisfying, let's add a second round of that as the penultimate wave. 2) very satisfying to see the remaining nuclear explosion strikes from the ground after they happened from the gunship or the SOL smoke. 3) it could be a time-unlock that once in a while SOL does targeted strikes to help us, automated. first 2 are manual, later ISAO calibrated it and it can do it auto. 4) UNITS are not showing all the units; we should see SOL, and the Gunship. also show Wireframe for all units. 5) https://jelaludo.github.io/SentryTowers_A6/ has new units for us. a) a better SOL to replace the current one (sol88) OR perhaps the story is that this one is automated... and replaces the old one, we launch it with the orbital launcher. we also have a CHIP Manufacturing unit, a Greenhouse, and bio containers to make the base more fully developed. We also need an armory/missile factory of sorts, and a spot for the tank to replenish its shells. check all the resources, plan the next move." Then: "before the next round of changes, git commit and git push these, and perhaps a /deban sync and starting a fresh session."
outcome: Recorded as the plan for the next session, not started. SURVEY of jelaludo/SentryTowers_A6 at 62015608 (2026-09-25): new families with manifests, lod1 (<=8000 tris, 10 draws, 400 KB) and lod2 (<=3000, 1 draw, 250 KB) tiers, plain GLB as source of truth, meshopt derived: sol88 (SOL-88 Syzygy orbital laser: three rotating cages, clips Idle_Cycle/Convergence/Firing_Cycle/Recovery, aim yaw +-35 deg pitch +-22, D0 only, lod1 sol88_platform_game.glb 386 KB, lod2 81 KB; 'cyan wireframe in game' is its primary presentation); orbital-launcher (ARC-01 mass driver + SEED-01 collector satellite, 30 s Collector_Launch clip: charge, launch, unfold six petals; engine nodes LAUNCH_SLED, CLAMP_L/R, PETAL_n_HINGE, PASSAGE_GATES; lod1 launcher 343 KB + satellite 56 KB); chip-manufacturing (LIT-01, Wafer_Write_Cycle 12 s loop, lod1 163 KB); greenhouse (VER-01, Cultivation_Service_Cycle 20 s loop, lod1 202 KB); settlement-industry (BOR-01 drill, furnace, hauler, mirror, cassette: the 'bio containers' are probably the cassette/logistics pieces, to confirm with the owner; lod1 per piece 15-204 KB); ammunition (cannon/mortar/missile projectile and case GLBs, game tiers 2.6-6.4 KB: the armory's stock); micro-reactor (core, exchanger, manifold, control, complex, D0-D3, 0.1-1.5 MB); research-outpost (barracks, infirmary, comms, operations, garage, logistics container, air launchpad, D0-D3); fabrication-lab (stalheart_mork_fabrication lod0-2); korp lod0-2 (we pin lod1). We already pin sol82, korp lod1, hugin launchpad, terraformer, solar, assembly, skyward radar, base kit, missiles, needle, ammunition's rotor case. PLAN, in order: (1) UNITS lab: add SOL-82 (and SOL-88 once pinned) and the KORP gunship as friendly fixtures from their pinned GLBs, and a wireframe toggle for every entry (src/unitcatalog.js, src/units-tab.js; the wireframe-stage.js reveal already draws wireframes for the briefings). (2) THE SECOND CANYON PASS: a second canyon sector as the penultimate wave of the arc, i.e. the sector before THE BACK DOOR (the schedule decides the door a sector ahead, so the canyon can be placed by the same rule), with a fresh canyon on another bearing or the same canyon re-filled; the pass's numbers from CANYON. (3) SOL AUTOMATED: after two manual passes Isao 'calibrates' it: a time-unlock perk where every later pass fires on its own at the densest breach/pile when the player is not in the seat (a pure targeting rule in domain, the arsenal's steer/hold from the game), announced with his line; the player can still take the seat. (4) SOL-88 + ARC-01: pin sol88 lod1/lod2 and orbital-launcher lod1/lod2 (a new lock file each, hashes from the manifests), the ARC-01 as a late base step Isao prints, its 30 s launch as the story beat that puts SOL-88 up (the satellite module stands in for SOL-88 on the rail), SOL-88 replacing SOL-82's model in the briefing/wireframe reveal and the Units lab; the automation (3) is the story reason for the new platform. (5) THE BASE GROWS: chip plant (LIT-01), greenhouse (VER-01) and bio containers as base-layout islands + programme steps with perks to decide (the owner's direction of 2026-09-24: self-sustaining colony); an ARMORY (candidate: research-outpost's logistics_container or industry_garage, with ammunition's shells as its dressing) as a programme step whose pad refills the tank's shells when the hull drives onto it (today shells come only from triads: td-tab ammo += 3), the shield array's pad being the model (src/fx/shield-array.js). Note 2 (the strikes seen from the ground) is praise: keep the MK-9 and SOL smoke as they are.
alternatives: Replacing SOL-82's model with SOL-88 outright: the owner offered both; the launch-and-automate story uses the new asset as a reward and keeps the first canyon pass as it is.
